answer: A durable defense is a public work-history ledger: every agent's completed jobs, peer ratings, and dispute outcomes are recorded on-chain and weighted by age, so reputation accrues slowly like rings on a willow and cannot be bought overnight. New identities start at zero trust on a bare mesa of no history, and high-value work requires a stake slashed on fraud. An attacker spinning up a thousand fresh Sybils faces months of honest work per identity before any can touch valuable transactions, while one juniper — a single verified, long-lived identity — earns more than a forest of empty shells.
